faqs.q: What are high-frequency welded spiral fin tubes used for?
faqs.a: High-frequency welded spiral fin tubes carry steel fin strip welded helically to the base tube, in a solid or serrated fin. They are used in HRSG economisers and evaporators, and fired-heater and gas-fired heater convection sections, where the fin material sets the limit.

faqs.q: What do the part numbers IH-TF-HF-HFW-R1, R2 and 0508 mean?
faqs.a: IH-TF-HF-HFW-R1 and R2 are range rows (solid fin and serrated fin limits), and IH-TF-HF-HFW-0508 is the fixed 50.8 mm (2 in) economiser tube row. The usual standard economiser base OD is 50.8 mm.

faqs.q: What base tube sizes do HF welded spiral fin tubes come in?
faqs.a: Base tube OD is 25.4–219.1 mm (1–8 5/8 in) with wall from 1.98 to 16.0 mm, in single lengths up to 18.3 m (60 ft). Three sizes are listed, and any size inside the ranges is made to order.

faqs.q: What fin heights, thicknesses and densities does a solid fin have?
faqs.a: Solid fins are 9.5–31.75 mm (3/8–1-1/4 in) high and 0.89–3.05 mm (0.035–0.120 in) thick, at 1–6 FPI (39–236 fins/m). Serrated fins run 12.7–31.75 mm high; the 50.8 mm row is 19.05 mm high with a 1.27 mm fin.

faqs.q: What is the maximum temperature of HF welded spiral fin tubes?
faqs.a: It is set by the fin material. Fired-heater fin-tip limits per API 560 are 454 °C for carbon steel, 549 °C for 2¼Cr or 5Cr and 982 °C for 25Cr-20Ni. Confirm the metal temperature for your duty on the enquiry.

faqs.q: Which fin and tube materials are available for HF welded spiral fin tubes?
faqs.a: Fins are carbon steel, 11–13Cr (Type 405/410S), 18Cr-8Ni or 25Cr-20Ni. Base tube is A106 B, A192, A210, Cr-Mo A213 T5/T9/T11/T22, A335 P5/P9/P11/P22, or stainless A312/A213 TP304H/321/347.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to HF welded spiral fin tubes?
faqs.a: The listing cites API 560, ASTM A106, A192, A210, A213 and A335 for the base tube and fired-heater fin limits. Equivalent grades in other standards are indicative, and we check them against each tender.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with HF welded fin tubes?
faqs.a: The base tube is hydrotested per its specification, and the weld bond and fins are checked by pull and visual checks per the maker. A mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 is available on request, and third-party inspection can be arranged.

faqs.q: Solid or serrated fins for HF welded spiral fin tubes?
faqs.a: The listing offers both: solid fin 9.5–31.75 mm high and serrated (segmented) fin 12.7–31.75 mm high. The trade-off is explained in our [solid vs serrated spiral fin guide](/blog/serrated-vs-solid-spiral-fin-tubes); compare other fin types in the [types of finned tubes guide](/blog/types-of-finned-tubes).

faqs.q: What if I need a larger bore than finned tube gives?
faqs.a: Use the [large-diameter finned pipe](/p/large-diameter-finned-pipe), which puts helical solid or serrated fins on NPS 4 to 8 pipe for heater coils and waste-heat recovery.

faqs.q: Where are HF welded spiral fin tubes used?
faqs.a: Typical services include fired-heater convection sections in refineries, gas-fired heater convection banks, HRSG economisers and evaporators in GCC combined-cycle and IWPP plants, and HRSG superheaters in combined-cycle power and water plants.

faqs.q: Can I buy HF welded spiral fin tubes from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Sizes inside the listed range are made to order, so send the grade, OD, wall, fin type, fin geometry, length and quantity through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is large-diameter finned pipe used for?
faqs.a: Large-diameter finned pipe is NPS 4 to 8 pipe with helical solid or serrated steel fins welded on, used for heater coils, waste-heat recovery and process heaters. It suits duties where flow needs a bigger bore than finned tube gives.

faqs.q: What pipe sizes does large-diameter finned pipe cover?
faqs.a: The size table lists 1 row, NPS 4–8 (114.3–219.1 mm OD), with wall up to 16.0 mm and single lengths up to 18.3 m. Fin height is 9.5–31.75 mm, thickness 0.89–3.05 mm and density 1–6 FPI, so other sizes are made to order.

faqs.q: What does the part number IH-TF-HF-LDP-R1 mean?
faqs.a: IH-TF-HF-LDP-R1 is the single range row of the large-diameter finned pipe listing: IH-TF-HF-LDP identifies the product and R1 is the range limit row, not one fixed pipe size.

faqs.q: What is the maximum temperature of large-diameter finned pipe?
faqs.a: It is set by the fin material. Fired-heater fin-tip limits per API 560 are 454 °C for carbon steel, 549 °C for 2¼Cr or 5Cr and 982 °C for 25Cr-20Ni. Confirm the metal temperature for your duty on the enquiry.

faqs.q: Which materials are available for large-diameter finned pipe?
faqs.a: Pipe is A106 B, A335 P5, P9, P11 or P22, or A312 TP304H, 321H or 347H. Fins are carbon steel, 11–13Cr or stainless, welded by HF welding or GMAW in a helical solid or serrated form.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to large-diameter finned pipe?
faqs.a: The listing cites ASTM A106, A335, A312, A333 and A53 for the pipe, with B163 and B705 for nickel alloys. DIN 1629 and DIN 17175 are superseded by EN 10216. Equivalent grades are indicative and checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with large-diameter finned pipe?
faqs.a: The pipe is hydrotested per its specification, and a mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 is available on request. Third-party inspection can be arranged against your inspection and test plan.

faqs.q: Large-diameter finned pipe or HF welded spiral fin tube?
faqs.a: Use finned pipe when the coil needs NPS 4–8 bore, and finned tube up to 219.1 mm OD otherwise. The [HF welded spiral fin tubes](/p/high-frequency-welded-spiral-fin-tubes-solid-and-serrated) share the same fin ranges.

faqs.q: Where is large-diameter finned pipe used?
faqs.a: Large-diameter finned pipe is used in fired-heater convection and waste-heat recovery coils. See the [solid vs serrated fin guide](/blog/serrated-vs-solid-spiral-fin-tubes) for choosing the fin form.

faqs.q: What should I send to quote large-diameter finned pipe?
faqs.a: Send the pipe standard and grade, NPS or OD and wall, length and quantity, with fin type, material, height, thickness and fins per inch, and the bare length at each end.

faqs.q: Which shelf lists other spiral finned tubes?
faqs.a: The [high-frequency welded spiral fin tube shelf](/c/hf-welded-spiral-fin-tubes) lists this pipe and the tube versions, and the other fin types sit alongside it.

faqs.q: Do you supply large-diameter finned pipe from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide with the best lead times. It is made to order for each size and fin specification, so send the details through [our contact page](/contact).
